subject: Could geom_inset place image of different size on branch?

messages.author: fb4292a8ba4134cb
messages.subject: Could geom_inset place image of different size on branch?
parts:
Prof. Yu:
      Thanks for the development of ggtree. Recently I have been trying to visualising evolutionary events on phylogenetic tree using ggtree. I combined nodebar function and  geom_inset function under the instruction of ggtree book attempting to visualise the number of two evolutionary events. Here is my code

bar2<-nodebar(barstat,cols=(1:2),position="dodge")
bar2<-lapply(bar2, function(g) g+scale_fill_manual(values=c('#817e5f','#d73635')))
p + geom_inset(bar2,width=.09,height=.08,x = "branch",vjust=.1) 

And I got the following graph. It seems that the geom_inset function puts every image of same size as specified by width and height on the branch? This hampers the visualisation of  number of events denoted by red bar. The height of red bars appears the same while in reality it should not be. Is there a workaround or solution in ggtree that could help me realise this?


Best regards
Ramon

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Could geom_inset place image of different size on branch?
parts:
then you need to use ggimage::geom_subview which supports aes mapping for width and height.

You can open an issue to request aes mapping for geom_inset.
